description: SUBMISSION.md Slide 5 (the judge-facing deck) claims the fresh-context adversary's findings were 'all fixed and re-verified' — but the very issue it names in the same sentence (the empty-string URL bug in the self-report path, i.e. round-1 FIND-003's sub-bug) is documented by the builder's own evidence as NOT re-verified live. evidence/trace-clawrouter-multiagent-round.txt (the artifact that discovered the bug) says verbatim: 'NOT yet re-verified live (this session ran out of disk immediately after finding this) — tracked as an open follow-up alongside task #21.' The parent spec's own TODO checklist marks this item '[~]' (partial), never '[x]'. This is the exact overstatement pattern round-1 FIND-002 was raised to eliminate ('the submission deck must not claim more verification than actually happened'), recurring in a different slide of the same fixed document.
